chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "When you intend to bow and prostrate, raise your hands, then bow and prostrate."
ai.seo_question: What is the ritual procedure for raising hands before bowing and prostrating in Shia prayer?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith specifies the ritual raising of hands (*raf' al-yadayn*) prior to *ruku'* and *sujud*, a practice emphasized in Shia jurisprudence to distinguish the completeness of the prayer movements. This narration underscores the importance of adhering to the Prophet’s and Imams’ prescribed manner (*sifah*) of worship, ensuring that the physical acts of devotion are performed with precision and reverence as taught by the Ahl al-Bayt.
